resources.string: Your Master Password derives the local AES-256-GCM encryption key. It is never transmitted and cannot be reset without your emergency recovery kit.

Moving from another phone? Choose your encrypted backup and enter its existing 12-word recovery kit. No new seed phrase is created.

This permanently deletes every record, key and biometric enrolment on this device. It cannot be undone. Only do this if you have lost both the Master Password and the 12-word Recovery Kit — otherwise use the kit to recover. Once erased, the data is gone forever.
